title: Archer pawn on DPC 0.9.30: reticle position and where arrows go
intro: About 90 s, three parts, each started with End. Arisen must be an Archer; an Archer pawn in the party; something to shoot at helps (a tree or rock is fine).

steps.text: 1/3 BASELINE. As the ARISEN (Archer, bow out). Press End, then HOLD AIM for 7 s and sweep the camera left/right and up/down
ARISEN: HOLD AIM, sweep the camera left/right and UP/DOWN...

expect.label: (info) Arisen: aim target sits on the camera's centre line

steps.text: 2/3 PAWN, arrows steered by the mod. Possess the ARCHER (F6 / F7), face something to shoot. Press End, HOLD AIM 9 s, shoot several arrows. Is the reticle centred? Do arrows hit where it points?
PAWN (steering ON): HOLD AIM and shoot. Reticle centred? Arrows on the reticle?

expect.label: aim camera held for the pawn
reticle active for the pawn (drawn by the mod)
pawn: aim target on the camera's centre line

steps.text: Release aim. Next: the same with steering OFF
3/3 PAWN, steering OFF (for comparison). Press End, HOLD AIM 9 s, shoot several arrows. Better or worse than part 2?
PAWN (steering OFF): HOLD AIM and shoot. Compare with part 2

expect.label: (info) pawn without steering: distance of his aim target from the centre line

probes.ctl:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
local c = mcc:get_field("_CurrentCameraController"); return c and c:get_type_definition():get_name()
probes.t_up:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
return H.node(mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"), 1)
probes.along:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return nil end
local t = ch:call("get_AimTargetPosition"); if not t then return nil end
local tr = sdk.get_primary_camera():call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Transform")
local p, z = tr:call("get_Position"), tr:call("get_WorldMatrix")[2]
local dx, dy, dz = t.x - p.x, t.y - p.y, t.z - p.z
local along = -(dx * z.x + dy * z.y + dz * z.z)
local lx, ly, lz = dx + along * z.x, dy + along * z.y, dz + along * z.z
return along
probes.lat:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return nil end
local t = ch:call("get_AimTargetPosition"); if not t then return nil end
local tr = sdk.get_primary_camera():call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Transform")
local p, z = tr:call("get_Position"), tr:call("get_WorldMatrix")[2]
local dx, dy, dz = t.x - p.x, t.y - p.y, t.z - p.z
local along = -(dx * z.x + dy * z.y + dz * z.z)
local lx, ly, lz = dx + along * z.x, dy + along * z.y, dz + along * z.z
return math.sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly + lz * lz)
probes.flow: local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager"); local ui = gm and gm:get_field("Aim"); return ui and ui:get_field("FlowNow")
probes.drawpos: local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager"); local ui = gm and gm:get_field("Aim"); return ui and H.v3(ui:get_field("DrawPos"))
probes.disp: local d = imgui.get_display_size(); return d.x .. "x" .. d.y
probes.dpc_aim:
local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json"); if not (ok and d) then return nil end
local a = d.aim; return a and string.format("hold=%s blocked=%s learned=%s seen=%s,%s n=%s pt=%s,%s fail=%s", tostring(a.hold), tostring(a.blocked), tostring(a.learned), tostring(a.seen_x), tostring(a.seen_y), tostring(a.seen_n), tostring(a.pt_x), tostring(a.pt_y), tostring(a.ret_fail))
